Our Journey

Our Story

Some love stories begin with fireworks. Ours began with a library card and a quiet conversation between the shelves. What started as a shared curiosity for ideas grew into something neither of us expected, and everything we ever needed.

📖
July 2024
We Met
We first met at the Toronto Public Library. A chance encounter between two people who shared a love for reading, ideas, and meaningful conversation. We became friends instantly, spending hours discussing books, life, and everything in between.
The Alchemist, by Paulo Coelho Educated, by Tara Westover Man's Search for Meaning, by Viktor Frankl The Kite Runner, by Khaled Hosseini Atomic Habits, by James Clear A Thousand Splendid Suns, by Khaled Hosseini
☕
Late 2024
Friends Who Couldn’t Stop Talking
What began as library meetups turned into coffee dates, long walks through the city, and conversations that lasted well past midnight. We discovered we shared the same values, the same dreams, and the same way of seeing the world.
🍽
Early 2025
Something More
By the beginning of 2025, we were spending every free moment together, cooking dinner, exploring Toronto, and building something beautiful without even realizing it. The friendship had quietly become something deeper.
❤
July 2025
More Than Friends
Exactly one year after we first met, we made it official. What had been growing between us could no longer be called friendship. It was love, and we both knew it. We became partners in every sense of the word.
💍
2026
Building Our Family
Today, we are ready to share our joy with the world. We are informing our families and closest friends that we want to build a life together, and we want to celebrate this decision with everyone who matters to us.
🍷
July 12, 2026
The Celebration
An evening of music, food, and love at La Vita Port Credit, surrounded by the people who shaped us. This is where our next chapter begins.
"We met between the pages of a book and found a story of our own, one we'll spend a lifetime writing together."
